title: WNBA三十年热度攀升 斯温·卡什谈体育商业新周期
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: All right, Swin, thank you for being here.
Happy to be here. As I said, I think you have just an incredible resume, both on and off the court, basketball Hall of Famer,
segments.zh: 很高兴来。我说过，你的履历非常出色，无论场上场下，篮球名人堂成员、

segments.en: studio analyst, and former executive. I wonder which one of those experiences just gave you the most knowledge about sports?
segments.zh: 演播室分析师、前高管。我想知道哪段经历让你对体育了解最多？

segments.en: I don't think there is one that I can just point to.
segments.zh: 我觉得没法只指出一个。

segments.en: I think for me, I've really been blessed to have worked on every side of the business when it comes to sports.
segments.zh: 对我来说，我很幸运能在体育行业的各个方面工作过。

segments.en: And I think now being back on the media side, being able to be an executive, being a player, you get to see all the different stakeholders
segments.zh: 现在回到媒体这边，做过高管、当过球员，你能看到所有不同的利益相关者

segments.en: and also an investor in the WNBA. You get to see the different perspectives of it all.
segments.zh: 也是WNBA的市场参与者。你能看到各种不同的视角。

segments.en: On the broadcasting side, because that's what you're doing currently at Amazon, what has that brought you that maybe you didn't know about before?
segments.zh: 在转播方面，你现在在亚马逊工作，这给你带来了哪些之前可能不知道的东西？

segments.en: I mean, on the player's side, of course, in your playing, you're talking to media, but now discussing players is a completely different issue.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，作为球员，当然，打球时你会和媒体交流，但现在讨论球员完全是另一回事。

segments.en: Well, it's changed a little bit. So when I came out of college out of UConn, I spent a lot of my career, not only just playing overseas,
segments.zh: 嗯，有点变化。我从康涅狄格大学毕业后，职业生涯大部分时间不仅在海外打球，

segments.en: playing WNBA, which shout out to all the women, they don't have to do that now, if they don't want to, but I also was able to do USA basketball
segments.zh: 打WNBA，向所有女性致敬，她们现在不必那样做了，如果不想的话，但我也能参加美国篮球

segments.en: and a number of different things.
